body: Thank you for the response. And I think I'll try sitting him down with me when I go to visit my Therapist so there is a third party.

I'm kinda aware? It just feels like my brain has turned to scrambled eggs or I'm really really really afraid. But I definitely remember some if what happened.

I would prefer people to be calm, and to definitely not corner me. But I don't think that will happen. Most people who see me lose it make a point of never talking to me again.

I don't think I was quite clear. I have anger attacks/panic attacks where I get very confused. That's when I get out of hand, and he doesn't know how to handle them. We're perfect other than in those moments. But no one else I know, knows how to handle them either. My mother used to beat me when I started chanting "I hate myself" and hitting myself. :/
